statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ); let U := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/16:ℝ)⌋₊; let B₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/4:ℝ)⌋₊; let B₂ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let band := fun (A L B : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (m : ℕ) => ∑ a ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun a => L < a ∧ a ≤ B ∧ A < m / a), (∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors a).filter (fun d => A < d), μ d) * w (m / a); let core := fun (n m : ℕ) => band (U n) (B₁ n) (B₂ n) (fun b => if Nat.sqrt n < b then (if b.Prime then Real.log (b:ℝ) else 0) else 0) m; let τ₂ := fun (n m : ℕ) => band (U n) (B₁ n) (B₂ n) ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt m; let J := fun (n : ℕ) (u v : ℕ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun x => S n u x * S n v x * E (-(n:ℝ)*x)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → ‖J n (core n) (core n)‖ ≤ e*(n:ℝ)) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → ‖J n (τ₂ n) (τ₂ n)‖ ≤ e*(n:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 若大素数余因子核心的深次弧积分是 o(n)，则 (2,2) 格点的深次弧积分也是 o(n)。
plain_statement.en: If the deep-arc integral of the large-prime core is o(n), then so is the deep-arc integral of the (2,2) cell.

brief.zh: 直接调用已核验的 transition_power_saving（B₂ n ≤ n^(1/3) 恰好满足），再三角不等式。核心估计仍待证明；核心只保留 m/a 为大于 √n 的素数的项。
brief.en: Apply the verified transition_power_saving (B₂ n ≤ n^(1/3) holds exactly), then the triangle inequality. The core estimate remains open; the core keeps only terms whose cofactor m/a is a prime above √n.
